{{Top|leg}}
"'''The Twilight Chant'''" was composed by the [[Kashoonara]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashoon]]. It was addressed to [[Hurrungat]] and his steed [[Aarwynn]] as they tied the day and night together. The text of the chant was:
{{Quote|O noble Hurrungat<br />Darkness calls, twilight falls<br />Across our world, across our tribes<br />Lead us then into the night<br />Of teeth and eyes and anger grave<br />Upon your steed Aarwynn, first humbaba<br />Of the sacred line born beneath the Tree-Queen's fingers.<br /><br />Great Hurrungat<br />The breezes cry for our lands<br />Crushed beneath the Tyrant's fist<br /><br />Great Aarwynn<br />Bear our twilight from us<br />Deliver us into angry darkness<br />Before the coming of the sun.|''The Twilight Chant''|<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
